defs.def: extremely bad or serious 极为恶劣的；十分严重的

ex.s: The severity of the microplastic problem.
That leaves many people with severe headache.

ex.t: 他们遭受了严重的困难。

ex.s: “Only if we discuss the consequences of our biophysical limits” the December warning letter says, “can we have the hope to reduce their speed, severity and harm”.
ex.t: “只有当我们讨论生物物理极限的后果，”12月的警告信写道，“我们才有希望减缓其速度、严重性和危害”。

ex.s: It doesn't cause any severe emotional discomfort, either.
ex.t: 它也不会造成任何严重的情绪不适。

defs.def: punishing sb in an extreme way when they break a particular set of rules 严厉的；重的

ex.s: Smog can be dangerous because it causes severe breathing problems and infections.
ex.t: 烟雾可能很危险,因为它造成严重的呼吸问题和感染.

ex.s: It led to a severe food crisis and threatened the livelihood of more than 9.5 million people.
ex.t: 它导致严重的粮食危机,威胁950多万人的生计。

ex.s: Now talk about how human interference led to such severe consequences for Macquarie Island.
ex.t: 现在谈谈人类的干涉 如何给麦克夸里岛带来如此严重的后果

ex.s: A third and still more severe shock came, and as I swayed on the pavement trying to keep my footing, I saw an extraordinary sight!
ex.t: 第三场更严重的震荡来了 当我在人行道上摇摆着 试图保持我的站姿时 我看见一个非凡的景象!

ex.s: On discovering that Morrie is being weakened by severe illness, Mitch starts visiting him at his house on Tuesdays.
ex.t: 在发现莫里因重病而衰弱后,米奇于星期二开始到他家探望他.

defs.def: not kind or sympathetic and showing disapproval of sb/sth 严厉的；苛刻的
extremely difficult and requiring a lot of skill or ability 艰难的；艰巨的；难度很大的
extremely plain and lacking any decoration 过于简朴的
